Several days (missions 1–6: 4–8 hours; mission 7: several team sessions)

{npc:Henricus} leads the Inquisition in Thais and recruits you to rid Tibia of demons. You interrogate guards, destroy the witches' potion, hunt the vampire The Count, cleanse a haunted house, kill the demon Ungreez and, finally, cross the Demon Forge with a large team to destroy the Shadow Nexus. You receive the {wiki:Demon Hunter Outfits|Demon Hunter Outfit} with both addons, one item of your choice out of ten, three achievements and access to the Blessing of the Inquisition.
The bravest players in Tibia are called to free Tibia from all evil demons.
Premium Account (missions 1 to 3 can be done without Premium).
Level 100 only for the last mission (150+ recommended for the whole team in mission 7). Ungreez and the first addon do not require level 100.

To enter the {wiki:Demon Forge|Demon Forge} (mission 7) you must have absorbed the spirit of at least one of {wiki:The Ruthless Seven|The Ruthless Seven} in the {wiki:The Pits of Inferno Quest|Pits of Inferno Quest}, and have reported Ungreez's mission.
Mission 7: large team with lots of damage and support.
to cut the Jungle Grass on the way to The Count
given by Henricus; keep it for mission 7
First Demon Hunter addon (mission 6) and second addon (final)

One item of your choice: {item:Emerald Sword}, {item:Hellforged Axe}, {item:Obsidian Truncheon}, {item:Warsinger Bow}, {item:Royal Crossbow}, {item:Spellbook of Dark Mysteries}, {item:Master Archer's Armor}, {item:Fireborn Giant Armor}, {item:Robe of the Underworld} or {item:Merudri Nanbando}
Access to the deeper areas of the Demon Forge
Being able to buy the {wiki:Blessing of the Inquisition|Blessing of the Inquisition} from Henricus
Achievements **High Inquisitor**, **Demonbane** and **Master of the Nexus**
Deeper areas of the Demon Forge
Mission 7: in each section you kill the boss and enter his teleport (up to 2 minutes later) to unlock the next area, all the way to the Shadow Nexus.
Every teleport unlocked in the Retreat becomes permanent.
When you report the last mission to {npc:Henricus}.
Bought from Henricus: all blessings at once, about 10% more expensive.
To get the outfit you only need missions 1 to 5, which are easy and do not require level 100.
Bring the 20 {item:Vampire Dust|Vampire Dusts} right away when you go to Storkus, to save a trip.
Use the {item:Garlic Necklace|Garlic Necklaces} trick against The Count: he can kill a level 85 mage in one turn with his summons.
Completing the quest up to mission 3 lets you start the {wiki:Vampire Hunter Quest|Vampire Hunter Quest} with {npc:Storkus}.
Do not lose the {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|holy water flask}: you need it to destroy the Shadow Nexus.
In **Thais**, go down one floor at the marked spot and talk to {npc:Henricus}. Say {key:hi}, {key:inquisitor}, {key:join} and confirm with {key:yes}. Then ask for a {key:mission}.
Take the *inquisitor's field guide* from the box in Henricus's back room.

You have to interrogate 5 guards in Thais (Walter, Kulag, Grof, Miles and Tim). If you do it well, a holy cross effect appears over you. Starting at the city's south entrance (near Henricus) and going clockwise, you meet the guards in this order.
Holy cross effect that appears when you interrogate a guard well
{npc:Miles, The Guard} is 2 floors above ground level. Say {key:hi}, {key:trouble}, {key:foresight of authorities}, {key:also for the gods} and {key:trouble will arise in near future}.
{npc:Tim, The Guard} is 1 floor above ground level. Say {key:hi}, {key:trouble}, {key:authorities}, {key:avoided} and {key:gods would allow}.
Go back to {npc:Henricus} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}.
Receive the mission and the holy water
Ask {npc:Henricus} for a {key:mission}. He wants {item:The Witches' Grimoire} and gives you a flask of holy water to destroy the witches' potion.

The {wiki:Femor Hills} lie between **Carlin**, **Ab'Dendriel** and **Kazordoon**. With Premium, the quickest way is the {wiki:Magic Carpet}: talk to a carpet pilot (Darashia, Edron, Farmine, Svargrond, Kazordoon or Issavi) and say {key:hi}, {key:femor hills} (or {key:hills}) and {key:yes}. You land on the carpet at the top of the Femor Hills, next to {npc:Uzon}. You can also go on foot: the hills are **east** of Carlin, **southwest** of Ab'Dendriel and **north** of Kazordoon.
Go to the **Femor Hills** flying carpet and talk to {npc:Uzon}: {key:hi}, {key:eclipse}, {key:yes}. He takes you to the witches' mountain. You arrive at a protection zone (PZ).
Go down to the witches' camp
Go down the ramp to the witches' camp.
There are up to 8 {creature:Witch|Witches}, 2 {creature:Ghoul|Ghouls} and a {creature:Dark Magician}, plus cats, rats and frogs to pester you.
Witches are weak to death damage: use {item:Sudden Death Rune|Sudden Death Runes} or {spell:Death Strike}.
Destroy the potion and steal the grimoire
Use the holy water flask on the **large cauldron** (an explosion appears over it). Then open the chest on your **left** and take {item:The Witches' Grimoire}.
Cauldron and chest in the witches' camp
Explosion that appears on the cauldron
Go back and hand in the grimoire

Talk to {npc:Uzon} again on the mountain ({key:hi}, {key:eclipse}, {key:yes}) to return to the Femor Hills carpet (the way back is always through him: there is no other exit from the witches' mountain). From there take a {wiki:Magic Carpet} or walk to a city and continue to Thais. Take the grimoire to {npc:Henricus} and report the {key:mission}.
Ask {npc:Henricus} for a {key:mission}. He sends you to the dwarf vampire hunter {npc:Storkus}, **west** of the Dwarf Bridge (near Kazordoon).
Path from the Dwarf Bridge to Storkus
Storkus asks for 20 {item:Vampire Dust}. Hand them over and ask for a {key:mission} again: he wants you to kill the vampire lord {creature:The Count}.

The Count is in the **Green Claw Swamp**, near the {wiki:Blood Herb Quest|Blood Herb Quest}. Bring a {item:Machete} (or equivalent) to cut the {item:Jungle Grass} along the way. Go down the hole, walk to the **right** and go down the next stairs. You see a buried coffin surrounded by 3 counters.
Map of the path to The Count
**Before** using the coffin, put 1 {item:Garlic Necklace} on each of the 3 counters. That way, when he appears, he will be {creature:The Weakened Count}, as weak as a normal {creature:Vampire}.
Where to place the Garlic Necklaces (on the 3 counters)
Without this trick, The Count can kill a level 85 mage in a single turn with his summons.
Use the coffin in the centre of the room to summon The Count. Kill him and pick up {item:The Ring of the Count}.

Go back the same way: go up the stairs, walk to the **left** and go up the hole with the {item:Rope}. Cross the swamp again (cut the {item:Jungle Grass} with the {item:Machete}) and return to the Dwarf Bridge, where {npc:Storkus} is.
Take {item:The Ring of the Count} to {npc:Storkus}. Then go back to {npc:Henricus} and report the {key:mission}.
Ask {npc:Henricus} for a {key:mission}. He gives you a {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|Special Flask} (holy water flask).
Use the holy water on the old house

Go to **Liberty Bay** by boat (for example, in Thais tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay} and {key:yes}) and find the old house. Use the flask on the north-westernmost corner of the house, as the image shows. The holy cross appears, a {creature:Pirate Ghost} spawns and the door closes.
Tile where you use the holy water (north-west corner)
Killing the Pirate Ghost is optional: wait about 10 seconds and the door opens again.
Go back to Thais by boat (at the Liberty Bay port tell the captain {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}) and report the {key:mission} to {npc:Henricus}.
Ask {npc:Henricus} for a {key:mission} and hand him 20 {item:Demonic Essence|Demonic Essences}. Then say {key:outfit} to receive the Demon Hunter Outfit (without addons).

The {wiki:Hero Cave} is **north** of Edron, below the valley near Cyclopolis and the dragon lairs ({coord:33164,31638,7}). Enter and go down **4 floors** to Ungreez's room ({coord:33144,31639,11}). Watch out for the {creature:Hunter|Hunters} guarding the entrance.

Ask {npc:Henricus} for a {key:mission}: he wants you to kill the demon {creature:Ungreez}. Go to the **Edron Hero Cave** and go down to Ungreez's spot (previous step). He is like a normal {creature:Demon}.
Ungreez takes 5–15 minutes to respawn (depends on how many players are online). Each player has to kill him once, meaning they have to be the one who deals the most damage.
Go back the same way, going up the same 4 floors to the surface, north of Edron. Then take a boat to Thais (at the Edron port: {key:hi}, {key:thais}, {key:yes}).
Report the {key:mission} to {npc:Henricus} to receive the first addon.
After you report this mission you can no longer enter Ungreez's room again.

The hardest part: you need a large team with lots of damage and support (150+ recommended for everyone). Bring the {item:Special Flask (Holy Water)|holy water flask}. The mission consists of fighting your way to a boss room, killing the boss and leaving through the teleport in under 2 minutes to unlock the next area, all the way to the Shadow Nexus.

If you enter before the boss dies or more than 2 minutes after, you return to the Retreat and **do not** unlock the next area. If you die in the boss room you also have to repeat it, even if the team kills the boss.
The bosses have to be killed in order (Latrivan and Golgordan are fought together).
Teleport at the start of each section
Takes you back to the Retreat (or to the previous subsection, if the area has no direct access from the Retreat) without losing progress: you can leave to restock.
You may be right next to the exit teleport. Do not move until you work out where you are.
Each unlocked teleport is permanent. You can stop and resume another day.
The Quest Log says nothing. Try the portals from the last to the first: the first one that works is the one you have to do. For The Hive you can check the Quest Log.

The Demon Forge is at the bottom of the **Edron Hero Cave** (entrance north of Edron, {coord:33164,31638,7}). Go down to the {wiki:Temple of Xayepocax}, a room with many different creatures; pass the **level 70** {item:Gate of Expertise} in the **south** of the room and step into the teleport behind the **level 100** door. As soon as you enter you are attacked by {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Fire Devil|Fire Devils} and {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}. Kill them and go **south** to the **Retreat**, the hub with teleports to each section (there are plaques on the wall showing the destination). You have no access to any yet: start with **The Dark Path**.
Temple of Xayepocax, where the teleport to the Demon Forge is

Go up the stairs **west** of the Retreat. Follow the path with {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters} and {creature:Massive Fire Elemental|Massive Fire Elementals} **east** and go up the stairs. Cross the great hall (Hall of the Colossi) to the **north**, with {creature:Stone Golem|Stone Golems}, {creature:Gargoyle|Gargoyles}, {creature:Behemoth|Behemoths} and {creature:Juggernaut|Juggernauts}. At the end of the hall is the teleport to {creature:Ushuriel}.
Be careful when pulling monsters: there are groups of up to 4 Juggernauts.
Juggernauts will not walk over energy fields.

Use a {item:Stealth Ring} (or {spell:Invisible}) and enter. {creature:Ushuriel} is not very strong for a competent group, but the {creature:Eye of the Seven|Eyes of the Seven} are deadly in a group: do not lose your invisibility. When Ushuriel dies, step into the portal (within 2 minutes) to go to the **Crystal Caves**.
Do not step into the teleport before Ushuriel dies: you return to the Retreat and have to redo the Dark Path.

You will meet {creature:Crystal Spider|Crystal Spiders}, {creature:Spectre|Spectres}, {creature:Ice Golem|Ice Golems} and then {creature:Hand of Cursed Fate|Hands of Cursed Fate}. Go as far **east** as possible. When you reach a wall, go **south** and then **west** until you find stairs. Go up to the **Mirror Maze of Madness**.
Here there are many {creature:Phantasm|Phantasms} (many are summons), {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders} and {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}. To cross the maze follow these directions:
North, east, go up the stairs
North, west, go down the stairs
North, east, north, go up the stairs
West, south, go down the stairs
South, west, north, go up the stairs
South, east, north, go down the stairs
North, west, north, go up the stairs
North, west, go up the stairs
You are in the teleport room

The teleport takes you to an underwater passage with {creature:Quara Predator|Quara Predators}, {creature:Quara Pincher|Quara Pinchers}, {creature:Quara Hydromancer|Quara Hydromancers} and {creature:Massive Water Elemental|Massive Water Elementals}. Go a long way **east** to the {creature:Zugurosh} teleport.

{creature:Zugurosh} is immune or strong against almost every element except **physical**; after that, the biggest weakness is **energy**. The {creature:Pillar|Pillars} around the room reduce your shielding to 1–11. It is an endurance fight that burns a lot of supplies.

Have a few paladins make Zugurosh walk over {item:Fire Field|Fire Fields} while they attack him: his invisibility is cancelled with every step. You can also summon {creature:Fire Elemental|Fire Elementals}.

After you kill him, the teleport takes you to the **Blood Halls**, which are extremely dangerous right at the entrance. It may be worth using the teleport back to the Retreat as soon as you get there, so the team can regroup and restock.

You face many {creature:Dark Torturer|Dark Torturers} (kill them first), {creature:Betrayed Wraith|Betrayed Wraiths}, {creature:Lost Soul|Lost Souls} and {creature:Hand of Cursed Fate|Hands of Cursed Fate}. Go **north** and **west** to the centre of the room, where there are stairs. Upstairs there is a huge number of these creatures: at least two very high-level knights (190+) go up and head for the corners, and the healers go up right behind them to heal them; alternatively, a 150+ mage goes up and immediately casts a UE ({spell:Rage of the Skies} or {spell:Eternal Winter}). Go **west**, then **south** to other stairs (use the same tactic). Then go **east** and **north** to a teleport.

The teleport takes you to a room with {creature:Juggernaut|Juggernauts}, {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}, {creature:Fury|Furies} and {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}. The shooters should make barriers with {item:Magic Wall Rune|Magic Wall}, otherwise many monsters come at once. After clearing the room, go to the **south-east** corner to the teleport to {creature:Madareth}. Kill him (sorcerers and druids with {item:Icicle (Rune)|Icicle Runes}, paladins with {item:Assassin Star|Assassin Stars} and {spell:Divine Missile}) and step into the teleport.

The Vats has many {creature:Son of Verminor|Sons of Verminor}, {creature:Plaguesmith|Plaguesmiths}, {creature:Blightwalker|Blightwalkers} and {creature:Defiler|Defilers}. Advance **east/north-east**, hugging the **south** wall to meet fewer monsters. At the far **east** end is the teleport to **The Battlefields**.
Use a {item:Dwarven Ring} because of the Blightwalkers.

Get ready for many {creature:Fury|Furies}, {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds}, {creature:Destroyer|Destroyers}, {creature:Blightwalker|Blightwalkers}, {creature:Hand of Cursed Fate|Hands of Cursed Fate}, {creature:Hellfire Fighter|Hellfire Fighters}, {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, {creature:Dark Torturer|Dark Torturers} and a few {creature:Juggernaut|Juggernauts}. Fight your way **east** to the teleport to {creature:Latrivan} and {creature:Golgordan}, who fight together (the room also has Flamethrowers, Magicthrowers, Plaguethrowers and Shredderthrowers). Kill both and step into the teleport.
The Arcanum and The Soul Wells

The Arcanum has {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}, {creature:Lich|Liches}, {creature:Hand of Cursed Fate|Hands of Cursed Fate}, {creature:Braindeath|Braindeaths}, {creature:Vampire|Vampires}, {creature:Undead Dragon|Undead Dragons}, {creature:Efreet|Efreets}, {creature:Diabolic Imp|Diabolic Imps} and {creature:Demon|Demons}. The path is a straight line through the 3 rooms to the **Soul Wells** teleport. In the Soul Wells ({creature:Betrayed Wraith|Betrayed Wraiths}, {creature:Spectre|Spectres}, {creature:Lost Soul|Lost Souls}, {creature:Phantasm|Phantasms}, {creature:Demon|Demons}) go **south** hugging the **west** wall to the {creature:Annihilon} teleport. Kill him (there are {creature:Lavahole|Lavaholes} that generate Deathspawns) and step into the teleport.

You are greeted by {creature:Nightmare|Nightmares}, {creature:Bonebeast|Bonebeasts}, {creature:Son of Verminor|Sons of Verminor} and {creature:Juggernaut|Juggernauts}. Go **north** to several ramps (more of these, {creature:Ancient Scarab|Ancient Scarabs} and {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds}). Keep going **north** to more ramps (with {creature:Giant Spider|Giant Spiders}). **North** again and a little **east** to the last set of ramps. Go up, kill the Juggernauts, Sons of Verminor, Nightmares and Demons and step into the {creature:Hellgorak} teleport.

{creature:Hellgorak} is very strong against **all** damage types. Everyone must use {spell:Convince Creature} on the {creature:Dreadbeast|Dreadbeasts} summoned in the room: they are the ones that damage him. This is the **only** way to kill him. Then step into the teleport to the **Shadow Nexus**.
**Do not use the teleport back to the Retreat** from the Shadow Nexus: the only way back is to retrace the path to the Hellgorak room.
Shadow Nexus: hold back the monsters

The final room has mostly {creature:Fury|Furies}, {creature:Juggernaut|Juggernauts}, {creature:Demon|Demons}, {creature:Undead Dragon|Undead Dragons} and {creature:Hellhound|Hellhounds}. There are **5 Magic Pillars**, each spawning 1 Demon endlessly: killing those Demons is a waste of supplies. The blockers hold the creatures while the others go to the magic wall in the centre of the room (the Shadow Nexus is the two red dots near the centre in the image; the pillars are in the blue circles).
Magic Pillars (blue circles) and the Shadow Nexus (red dots in the centre)
Placing parcels or field runes around the Magic Pillars does not stop them from summoning Demons. A high-level druid should cast {spell:Mass Healing} repeatedly in this phase.
Shadow Nexus: use the flask on the magic wall

1) Use the flask on the magic wall to electrify it. 2) When it changes from electric to a burnt {item:Fire Field} on top, use the flask again; it goes back to the electric state and, 20 seconds later, back to the burnt Fire Field. 3) Use the flask a 3rd time: the magic wall becomes fully ablaze, with a full Fire Field on top. 4) Use the flask **one more time** on the full Fire Field to complete the mission.
Team next to the Shadow Nexus magic wall

The full Fire Field lasts about 10 seconds and only 4–5 players can complete the mission each cycle (on Optional-PvP servers everyone can stand on the same tile). Then it goes back to the start and you have to repeat the steps.

When you finish the mission, you can use the Shadow Nexus teleport that takes you back to the **Retreat**. Midway through the Demon Forge, to leave and restock, use the teleport at the start of the section you are in (progress is saved). From the Retreat, go back the way you came in to the Temple of Xayepocax, go up through the Hero Cave to the surface, north of Edron, and take a boat to Thais ({key:thais}).
Until you finish the mission, **do not** use the teleport back to the Retreat in the Shadow Nexus: the only way back is to retrace the path to the Hellgorak room.

Go back to {npc:Henricus} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. The quest is complete and you earn the achievement **High Inquisitor**. You can also now buy the {wiki:Blessing of the Inquisition|Blessing of the Inquisition} (all blessings at once, about 10% more expensive).
Say {key:outfit} to {npc:Henricus} to receive the second Demon Hunter addon and the achievement **Demonbane**.
Male Demon Hunter with both addons
Female Demon Hunter with both addons
Demon Hunter second addon and Demonbane achievement
Choose the item in the Reward Room
Now you can enter the **Reward Room**. You can only choose **one** of the ten prizes. When you take the item you earn the achievement **Master of the Nexus**.
The choice is final: you can only take one item.
One item of your choice and the Master of the Nexus achievement
The Demon Forge can be done in several sessions: each teleport unlocked in the Retreat is permanent.
Completing the quest up to mission 3 unlocks the {wiki:Vampire Hunter Quest|Vampire Hunter Quest} with {npc:Storkus}.
